status: source fix and focused execution passed; full-app emulator rerun pending
observedFailure: Android full-app341395c6 showed the RECORD_AUDIO permission dialog immediately after sign-in, covering Home before any call action.
cause: The pinned CallKeep4.6.1 Android setup wrapper calls checkPhoneAccountPermission, which requests RECORD_AUDIO and phone permissions. Auth hydration and IncomingCallListener both invoked this helper.
change: Android initialization uses registerPhoneAccount, registerAndroidEvents and setAvailable. These do not request runtime permissions.
Background native fallback requires the quiet hasPhoneAccount check. If disabled, ungranted or rejected, the authoritative notification fallback remains available.
CallContext retains explicit microphone/camera permission checks before creating or accepting a call.
iOS retains CallKit setup and all native event replay behavior.

Subscribe to didLoadWithEvents on both platforms before native registration, so the Android cold queue is replayed before the library drains it. A queued hangup supersedes its answer and duplicate actions remain suppressed.

verification.notes: Seven new cases execute the installed CallKeep JavaScript facade and event dispatcher against a native boundary fixture, including the Android startObserving queue drain, in addition to eight lifecycle cases.

limitations: These cases do not prove Android OS behavior. The complete app rerun must confirm the sign-in permission dialog is absent.
A separate5-second Auth lock-acquisition warning was observed during the earlier synthetic cold startup. It is not explained or claimed fixed by this permission change.
Physical-device incoming-call delivery, lockscreen integration and microphone/camera permission choices still require device acceptance.

New Android installs continue to use the in-app and full-screen notification calling paths until the optional managed phone account and phone permissions are enabled. This change does not add an enabling flow or prompt for those phone permissions.
